subject: Your 68-day Sound DNA is ready
preview_text: We built something only long-term listeners see. Check your personalized report.
body_paragraphs: Two months ago, you downloaded Loudify. That alone says something about how you listen — you don't settle for quiet, muddy audio. You want control. So here's a thank you that's more than words: your personal 68-day Sound DNA report is now live in the app.

Most apps forget you after week one. Not this one. Your Sound DNA tracks every listening move you've made — what profiles you used, how much boost you actually dialed in, and which headphones got tuned most. It's your audio fingerprint, and you're one of the first to see it at this depth.

Open Loudify, go to your Sound DNA tab. You'll see your top listening streaks, the headphones that earned the most EQ sessions, and a breakdown of your volume patterns over 68 days. It's like a year-end recap, but for your ears. And it's exclusive to users who stuck around this long.
One tap gets you in. P.S. — Your AutoEQ presets are still tuned to your headphones, even if you haven't used them in a week. Plug them in and hear the difference.
